| '''0 side — A Stunning Move'''<br />''Deploy Palpatine’s Quarters, Private Platform, and Insidious Prisoner.''<br /><br />'''For''' remainder of game, Sidious and Imperials are lost. Once per turn, may ▼ a Blockade Flagship site. Blockade Flagship may not be ‘blown away.’<br /><br />'''While''' this side up, Insidious Prisoner only follows opponent’s characters when moving to Palpatine’s Quarters. Once per game, may ▼ (for -2 Force) Cyborg Commander or The Count to a site you occupy.<br /><br />'''Flip''' this card if Insidious Prisoner is on Blockade Flagship.<br />'''7 side — A Valuable Hostage'''<br />'''Immediately''' ▲ (or retrieve into hand) a [Presence] droid.<br /><br />'''While''' this side up, immunity to attrition of opponent’s Jedi, starships, and vehicles is limited to &lt; 5. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground you control. Once during your turn, may search your Force Pile and reveal any one card; reshuffle. Opponent may lose 2 Force to place that card on bottom of your Used Pile; otherwise, take it into hand.<br /><br />'''Flip''' this card if Insidious Prisoner not at a Blockade Flagship site.  ||  '''0 side — A Stunning Move'''<br />''Deploy Palpatine’s Quarters, Private Platform, and Insidious Prisoner.''<br /><br />'''For''' remainder of game, Sidious and Imperials are lost. Once per turn, may ▼ a Blockade Flagship site. Blockade Flagship may not be ‘blown away.’<br /><br />'''While''' this side up, Insidious Prisoner only follows opponent’s characters when moving to Palpatine’s Quarters. Once per game, may ▼ (for -2 Force) {{Errata hl|1=Dooku}} or {{Errata hl|1=Grievous}} to a site you occupy.<br /><br />'''Flip''' this card if Insidious Prisoner is on Blockade Flagship.<br />'''7 side — A Valuable Hostage'''<br />'''Immediately''' ▲ (or retrieve into hand) a [Presence] droid.<br /><br />'''While''' this side up, immunity to attrition of opponent’s Jedi, starships, and vehicles is limited to &lt; 5. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground you control. Once during your turn, may search your Force Pile and reveal any one card; reshuffle. Opponent may lose 2 Force to place that card on bottom of your Used Pile; otherwise, take it into hand.<br /><br />'''Flip''' this card if Insidious Prisoner not at a Blockade Flagship site.
